name: Prebiotic fibres
short: Fructooligosaccharides, one prebiotic fibre, are highly fermentable and may cause bloating and flatulence; a meta-analysis of eight trials found no more gut symptoms than in comparison groups.
text: A meta-analysis of eight randomised trials of fructooligosaccharides, one type of prebiotic fibre, noted that because these fibres are highly fermentable they may be associated with bloating and flatulence, but found no difference in adverse gastrointestinal symptoms between supplement and comparison groups. A network meta-analysis of trials of probiotics, prebiotics and synbiotics for chronic constipation in adults found no statistically significant differences in adverse events between intervention and control groups; that result pools all three product types and is not specific to prebiotic fibre. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
